rule: Include concrete LP2 decoding, extraction, key-search and LP2-56 target-search attempts. Include direct transformations screened statistically, even when the source calls them measurements. Exclude general description, corpus statistics, tooling calibration, provenance audits, historical solutions and work whose target is another puzzle object. This is a reviewed selection over the pinned corpus, not all possible LP2 ideas.

explicit_exclusions.cc-roman-matrix-replay: Reproduces number-grid contacts and selected numerical coincidences; no rune-to-plaintext rule is supplied.
explicit_exclusions.direct-polynomial-streams: Tests whether ciphertext itself is polynomial-generated, without a plaintext/key decoding model.
explicit_exclusions.dukotah-h03-onion-cookie-xor: Targets a different puzzle blob rather than LP2.
explicit_exclusions.dukotah-line-geometry-channel-replay: Image measurement and detector calibration; no decoded LP2 channel demonstrated by the test.
explicit_exclusions.fehu-coordinate-triad: Coordinate coincidences rather than a specified LP2 decoding operation.
explicit_exclusions.haplography-diagonal-bound: Missing-rune/statistical premise rather than a decoding attempt.
explicit_exclusions.lp2-turtle-spatial-replay: Tests drawing shapes rather than decoding LP2.
explicit_exclusions.prime-distance-reverse-add: Arithmetic example and shuffle comparison, without a decoding rule.
explicit_exclusions.public-lp2-as-pad: Uses LP2 as a key to decrypt other objects, rather than deciphering LP2.
explicit_exclusions.wulfic-early-keyspace-diagnostics: Statistical diagnostics rather than a concrete decoding grid.
explicit_exclusions.wulfic-letter-encoding-bounds: Frequency-model feasibility, without a decoding attempt.
explicit_exclusions.wulfic-two-time-pad-premise: Audit of copied-region premises rather than plaintext recovery.
